funding.meter.label.description: Label of the funding meter: how far this month's income from the supporters goes toward the server's monthly goal. month is the month and year, such as November 2026.

funding.meter.percent.defaultMessage: {estimated, select, true {{percent} couvert, estimation} other {{percent} couvert}}
funding.meter.percent.description: The value of the funding meter in words, shown beside the bar and read by screen readers, while the server publishes only the percentage. percent is formatted, such as 72%, rounded down. estimated is true when the goal includes estimated costs.

funding.meter.amounts.defaultMessage: {estimated, select, true {{income} sur {target} ({percent}), estimation} other {{income} sur {target} ({percent})}}
funding.meter.amounts.description: The value of the funding meter in words, shown beside the bar and read by screen readers, while the server publishes the amounts: this month's income after fees, the monthly goal, and the percentage (rounded down). estimated is true when the goal includes estimated costs.

funding.meter.covered.defaultMessage: {estimated, select, true {Couvert ce mois-ci, estimation} other {Couvert ce mois-ci}}
funding.meter.covered.description: The value of the funding meter in words once this month's income reaches the goal. It never says a percentage above 100. estimated is true when the goal includes estimated costs.

funding.meter.target.costs.defaultMessage: L’objectif correspond aux coûts de fonctionnement de ce mois.
funding.meter.target.costs.description: Under the funding meter, while the server publishes the amounts: the monthly goal is what running the server costs this month.

funding.meter.target.amount.defaultMessage: L’objectif est de {target} par mois, fixé par les opérateurs.
funding.meter.target.amount.description: Under the funding meter, while the server publishes the amounts: the monthly goal the operators set. target is a formatted amount, such as ¥5,000.

funding.meter.estimated.defaultMessage: Les coûts incluent les frais d’utilisation d’un mois que le prestataire n’a pas encore clos : ils peuvent donc encore changer.
funding.meter.estimated.description: Under the funding meter when its goal includes estimated costs: why the value is an estimate.

funding.panel.title.description: Heading of the funding meter's panel in the third column of wide screens, which the operators turn on.

funding.panel.more.defaultMessage: En savoir plus sur les coûts de fonctionnement
funding.panel.more.description: Link from the funding meter's panel in the third column to the server's information page.
